translation: [#P04Now] starting the Puzzle Phase tutorial.

[#P04In] the Puzzle Phase, you will navigate
alternate space with an SOS Brigade member.

[#P04The] objective is to cause the alternate
space to naturally dissolve…
[#P04]…before Haruhi Suzumiya arrives.

[#P04In] order to do that, you must find the hidden
"singularities” on the map…
[#P04]…and then materialize and erase them.

[#P04On] the bottom left of the screen, "Left”
counts the remaining number of singularities.
[#P04Next] to it is the "Goal” number, which counts…

[#P04]…the minimum number of singularities you must
erase to clear the stage.
[#P04In] order to clear the Puzzle Phase, you must…

[#P04]…either erase all of the singularities, or
achieve the goal before "Time's Up” occurs.

[#P04If] you are unable to find and erase the goal
number of singularities…

[#P04]…before the time limit shown on the top screen
runs out…
[#P04]…it will result in Game Over.

[#P04In] alternate space, you are able to do the
following actions with your Brigade member.
[#P041]. "Movement”
[#P04Touch] a location and they will move there.
[#P042]. "Area Search”

When the search icon on the upper left of the
screen is off, tap at your member's feet.

Doing so will select the center tile and the
eight surrounding tiles (nine tiles total)…
…and perform an area search.

Depending on the area searched, you may be
able to find hidden singularities.

However, you will not be able to materialize
singularities with an area search.

Once you've inferred the position of a hidden
singularity by the markers near your feet…

…please materialize the singularity by using
the "Point Search” action.
[#P043]. "Point Search”

When you touch the "Search Icon” at the
upper left of the screen…

…an icon indicating point search mode will
appear over the member's head.

If you touch a specific tile while in this mode,
the brigade member will move…

…to the adjacent tile, and perform a point
search.

If you search a point that contains a hidden
singularity…
…this will force it to materialize.

You can only use point search to search one
tile at a time…

…but this serves as the basic action to
materialize a singularity.

If you want to perform the area search
action again, turn off the search icon.

Please be careful to not confuse these two
modes.

When you search, the marks near your feet
indicate the odds of a singularity existing.

The "!” mark on a tile indicates that a
singularity exists on one of…

…the surrounding nine tiles, including the tile
at your feet.

The number of "!” marks will increase
according to how many singularities…
…exist in the tiles surrounding it.

Once a singularity has materialized, rub it
with your stylus to erase it.

If you rub an area slightly wider than it
appears, you can erase it more efficiently.

As a final reminder, please be mindful of the
time limit when finding and erasing singularities.
